designationHistory.indexText: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service established Grand Bay National Wildlife Refuge under the Emergency Wetlands Resources Act to protect Gulf Coast wet pine savanna.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Grand Bay National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, 508 Grand Bay National Wildlife Refuge Comprehensive Conservation Plan (ServCat 168346): "Grand Bay NWR was established in 1992"; "established under the authority of the Emergency Wetlands Resources Act of 1986"

designationHistory.indexOriginal: The refuge was established in 1992 to help protect one of the largest remaining expanses of Gulf Coast wet pine savanna habitat.
